Renee (Eng): Hey folks — planning parental leave starting Mon Dec 4 for 10 weeks. Im also switching visa sponsorship the week before. Two quick things: 1) what paperwork/timing to ensure Redwood parental top-up and tax withholding are correct across the visa change? 2) I own a short-term contractor (payments to US LLC) — whats the fastest way to keep them paid and transfer day-to-day while Im out?

People Ops Bot: Start the formal leave via https://hr.redwood.com/leave and attach supporting docs (birth/adoption cert, new visa + passport pages, proof of address if residency changes). For contractor and vendor flows, file hiring-ops@redwood.com.

Payroll (Finance): For parental top-up to apply on the first leave payroll, upload all docs at least 10 business days before Dec 4. Visa/sponsorship changes can affect withholding; if your tax residency changes, cc finance-relocation@redwood.com immediately so we can adjust withholding and notify our payroll vendor.

Renee (Eng): If my visa sparks a foreign tax residency mid-leave, will Redwood withhold locally or do I handle that? Also, will parental top-up get pro-rated if payroll sees a cross-border split?

Payroll (Finance): If you become a foreign tax resident, withholding depends on the employer's reporting obligations and the payroll vendor's capabilities. In many cases, local withholding is required and well coordinate with legal to determine obligations. Parental top-up is processed per payroll rules; if a pay period spans two jurisdictions we may need to prorate or process separate runs. Well triage after you submit docs.

Legal: Tagging in  if residency changes well need to check treaty impacts and reporting. Please attach visa docs and expected dates. Dont assume liability for local taxes — well advise on withholding vs. employee reporting.

Renee (Eng): Re: contractor  they are paid to a US LLC monthly. Can we keep paying the same way while Im on leave? If not, what's the EOR route to avoid pause?

Hiring Ops: Fastest path: submit a Contractor Continuity request to hiring-ops@redwood.com with manager approval and billing contact. If the contractor remains a US entity and SOW is unchanged, payments can often continue uninterrupted. If vendor jurisdiction changes, we may need new paperwork or an EOR (employer-of-record) engagement which can take ~7-12 business days. Include invoice cadence and PO info in the ticket to speed approval.

Renee (Eng): Great. Also small admin Q: my RSU vesting has a scheduled tranche on Dec 15 — does taking leave affect vesting or taxation?

Payroll (Finance): Vesting events are governed by the equity plan; leave generally does not pause vesting unless specified in the grant. Tax withholding on vesting follows standard rules and may be affected if your tax residency changes. Equity team will confirm any nuances; cc equity@redwood.com when you file your leave so we can coordinate.

People Ops: You can keep limited/async check-ins with manager approval. On the leave form set availability to 'Limited  timezone constrained' and note your preferred weekly window. Also add an emergency contact and backup owner for critical tasks.

Renee (Eng): I'm going to nominate Priya to own the contractor and Alex to handle on-call. I'll drop a 1-page handoff and a short candidate/interview note.

Hiring Ops: Please include contractor PO and billing contact in the ticket. Priya, if you accept ownership, Hiring Ops can set a temporary approver so invoices route without Renee.

Renee (Eng): Uploading docs now. Quick checklist I'm pasting here for visibility:

```
- Submit leave form: https://hr.redwood.com/leave
- Upload: birth cert, new visa + passport pages, proof of address if relocating
- Upload >= 10 business days before Dec 4 for payroll top-up
- CC finance-relocation@redwood.com for tax/residency changes
- File Contractor Continuity request to hiring-ops@redwood.com with PO/invoice samples
- Nominate Priya for contractor approvals + Alex for on-call
- Set Limited availability on form and emergency contact
- CC equity@redwood.com about Dec 15 RSU vesting
```

Priya (People Ops): Happy to own the contractor approvals while you're out, Renee. Priya (Hiring Ops)  I'll work with you on the ticket and get PO routing set up.

Legal: Once Renee uploads visa docs, we'll confirm any withholding obligations and advise on cross-border payroll.

Renee (Eng): Thanks everyone  will post the handoff and confirm ticket numbers once submitted :white_check_mark:
